column1: # Label cleaning, layer 1: dialect and reduced spellings of common words (cleaning plan "Layer 1", "Dialect
# spellings"; training/cleaning.py). "dialect<TAB>standard": the dialect form becomes its standard
# spelling. Matched case-insensitively on whole tokens (an edge apostrophe is part of the form).
# A capital first letter is kept ("Gonna" -> "Going to"); capitals in the standard spelling ("I'm") are written
# Disabled by the net-harm check (cleaning plan Check 3, on the human-reference labels): 'cause, 'em, dunno, kinda,
# sorta, and the g-dropped allowlist (judged as one class, cleaning plan v4).
